description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of responses across six categories, labeled 0 through 5, from the Fair-PP synthetic dataset designed to align large language models with personalized preferences related to social equity. The largest segment, labeled “2,” accounts for 22.4% (6,583 responses) and is colored light green. The second-largest segment, “0,” represents 13.3% (3,910 responses) in pale yellow. Segment “1” follows closely at 13.8% (4,046 responses), also in a light yellow hue. The top segment, “5,” comprises 27.2% (8,006 responses) and is shaded in medium blue, making it the most prominent slice. Smaller segments include “3” at 6.8% (2,002 responses) in olive green, and “4” at 6.2% (1,810 responses) in light blue. Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage and absolute count, and the chart uses distinct pastel colors for visual differentiation, though no legend is provided. The segments appear ordered clockwise from the top, starting with “5,” and the chart does not use exploded slices or additional annotations beyond the numerical labels.
